en.quote: …improve Russia’s position in the World Bank’s ease-of-doing-business ranking from 120th in 2011 to 50th in 2015 and 20th in 2018.
en.head: Russia ranked 31st in the report released in 2018.
en.body: The World Bank’s Doing Business 2019 report, published in October 2018, ranked Russia 31st of 190 economies. That was a substantial rise from the 120th position cited in the decree, but short of the top-20 target for 2018.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 596, “On Long-Term State Economic Policy”

osrc.t: World Bank, Doing Business 2019: Russian Federation
